nodes.label: steps.py lane: lane decision from ticket and plan facts
nodes.accept: `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/steps.py lane <fixture ticket dir>` prints fix for a size-S fixture, lean for a two-step L2 plan, full for the same plan with one step at L4; selftest covers all three

nodes.label: skips.md record and the tickets.py check guard on closed lean/fix tickets
nodes.accept: `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/tickets.py --root <fixture> check` fails a done ticket whose skips.md lacks the planner line and passes once the line exists; steps.py lane writes the lane line into skips.md

nodes.label: chain, fix, conductor and planner contract text: lean lane, coarse-step rule, close-out rule
nodes.accept: `bash plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/check.sh` passes with a new check.py guard that the chain skill names `steps.py lane` and the planner contract holds the coarse-step rule; a copy with the rule removed fails the guard

nodes.label: steps.py lint warning for a lean-eligible plan that is finer than the rule
nodes.accept: `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/steps.py lint <three-step L2 plan>` exits 0 and prints one warning line; a two-step plan prints none; selftest case for both

nodes.label: replan delta format inside the run.sh result naming (newest planner-L*.md carries a `revises:` header and only changed steps)
nodes.accept: `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/steps.py review <task with planner-L2.md and planner-L3-2.md delta>` still reports `2 planner results (a replan)`; `order.py newest <task> planner` returns the delta file

nodes.label: steps.py split merges the base plan with its deltas and refuses a delta that does not apply
nodes.accept: `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/steps.py split <task>` writes step handoffs from base plus delta with unchanged steps verbatim from the base; a delta naming step 9 of a 3-step plan is refused with a `plan defect:` last line; `steps.py resolve <task>` prints the merged plan

nodes.label: plan-reviewer read rule for a delta plan (base plus revisions, not only the newest file)
nodes.accept: `grep -n 'revises' plugins/sdlc-lite/agents/plan-reviewer.md` finds the rule; `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/codex_roles.py check` passes for the regenerated Codex agents

nodes.label: planner rule to cite plan anchors instead of restating settled decisions, and the lint for a dangling anchor
nodes.accept: `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/steps.py lint <plan whose step cites #decision-x that the plan lacks>` exits 1 naming the anchor; the same plan with the anchor present exits 0

nodes.label: ## Carry forward section in scout, researcher, archaeologist and architect contracts, and the reader rule in planner and builder
nodes.accept: `grep -l '## Carry forward' plugins/sdlc-lite/agents/{scout,researcher,archaeologist,architect}.md | wc -l` prints 4 and check.py has a guard with a negative control for it; `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/codex_roles.py check` passes

nodes.label: scripts/footprint.py: files, bytes and role runs per ticket, with selftest
nodes.accept: `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/footprint.py .sdlc/.0181-messages-wait` prints files=51 bytes=214502 md=185323 runs=15; `footprint.py selftest` passes

nodes.label: fanout.py resolves lane ticket folders through tickets.ticket_dir
nodes.accept: `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/fanout.py selftest` holds a `ticket_root: tickets` case whose lane finds tickets/<slug>/handoff.md; with the resolver call reverted the case fails

nodes.label: tickets.py `layout:` key: topics default for new repos, flat for old, roadmap and notes paths resolved through one function, strays on the root
nodes.accept: `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/tickets.py selftest` holds cases: layout topics puts roadmap at tickets/roadmap.md and notes at notes/notes.md; a repo with no config line keeps <root>/roadmap.md; an unsupported layout value refuses every command

nodes.label: onboard.py writes layout: topics and the folder entry files for a new repo
nodes.accept: `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/onboard.py <empty tmp repo>` creates .sdlc/config with `layout: topics`, tickets/AGENTS.md, work/AGENTS.md, notes/AGENTS.md; onboard.py selftest covers it and the managed AGENTS.md template version is bumped

nodes.label: tickets.py check guards: entry file per topic folder, no stray root content under layout: topics
nodes.accept: `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/tickets.py --root <topics fixture> check` fails on a stray root folder and on tickets/ without AGENTS.md, passes on the clean fixture

nodes.label: tickets.py migrate-layout: dry run, dirty-tree refusal, moves, citing-file scan, idempotent
nodes.accept: `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/tickets.py --root <flat fixture with cites> migrate-layout --rewrite-refs` moves folders, rewrites the cite, writes layout: topics, and a second run prints `nothing to move`; a dirty tree is refused; `--dry-run` writes nothing (git status unchanged)

nodes.label: board.py, statusline.sh, traces and the 38 citing docs and skills follow the resolved layout
nodes.accept: `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/board.py --root <topics fixture>` lists tickets/<slug> tasks; `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/traces.py selftest` holds a topics-layout case; `grep -rn 'sdlc/roadmap.md' plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/onboard.py` prints the resolved form

nodes.label: whole-ticket verifier: run.sh family rule reads every step's newest builder when the verifier runs at the task dir, and chain text for when batching is allowed
nodes.accept: `SDLC_DRY_RUN=1 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/run.sh verifier L1 <task>/handoff.md` with a sonnet builder in step-1 and an opus builder in step-2 prints model=opus; `run-selftest.sh` holds the case and the negative control (no builder in any step keeps sonnet)

nodes.label: file-overlap check between tickets before fanout launch, from the planner's Files line
nodes.accept: `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/fanout.py run <two specs whose Files lines share check.py>` refuses before any worktree is made and names the file; disjoint specs launch

nodes.label: fanout queues required plan reviews back to back on one family
nodes.accept: `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/fanout.py selftest` holds a case where two lanes needing review run their plan-reviewer stage serially and the lane log shows the order

nodes.label: version lines (`plan: 2` on delta-aware plans, `layout:` default per repo age) and the upgrade note
nodes.accept: `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/steps.py split <old plan without a plan: line>` still splits; CHANGELOG names migrate-layout and the flat default for existing repos; `python3 scripts/check-packaging.py` passes

nodes.label: live evidence: one lean and one full ticket end to end on Claude and Codex with footprint recorded
nodes.accept: `ls docs/validation/lean-sdlc-live-run.md` exists and holds footprint lines for both lanes on both hosts, and a `steps.py lane` line routing a steps.py-touching ticket to full

write a replan as a delta the pipeline still counts as a replan
produce the merged plan that split and the reviewer read
refuse a delta naming a missing step or one that does not apply
write step handoffs that cite settled decisions instead of restating them
catch a dangling anchor before a builder reads it
carry research facts forward once so later roles do not re-derive them
make the planner and builder read carried facts before searching
measure files, bytes and role runs per ticket before and after
resolve the ticket folder root through one function in every consumer
let fanout lanes find tickets under tickets/
give a new repo the topics layout and its entry files
fail check on a stray root folder or a topic folder without its entry file
migrate a flat repo in one idempotent command with a dry run and a dirty-tree refusal
keep references to moved folders resolvable or name the citing files
keep roadmap and notes writable and readable after they move
update every doc and skill that prints a .sdlc path
verify a whole ticket in one run on a family none of its builders used
check declared file overlap before launching parallel lanes
run several tickets' plan reviews back to back

keep flat-layout repos working unchanged after the topics default ships
ship a negative control for each new guard

edges.why: lane writes the first skips.md line, so the file shape is pinned by lane
the chain and conductor text name the lane command and its output lines
split parses the revises header the naming step pins
the reviewer read rule names the delta header
anchors resolve against the merged plan split produces
check reads the layout key the resolver defines
migrate writes the layout key and the resolved paths
onboard writes the config line the resolver reads
a new repo defaulting to topics must already fan out
the chain text describes the family rule run.sh enforces at the task dir
the live run migrates a throwaway repo
the live run records the lane line
